title: Transition from Copy to Rewind
statement: Let $x$ be a binary word. From state $0$, with the input head at position $|x|+1$, all bits of $x$ copied onto the work tape, and the work head at cell $|x|$, one step of the three-state palindrome machine reaches state $1$ with the input head at position $|x|$. The work tape and work-head position are unchanged, and the output remains empty.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word of length $n$. From the configuration of the three-state
palindrome machine on input $x$ in copy state with the input head on the right
boundary blank (cell $n+1$), all $n$ bits copied, and work head at cell $n$, one
transition switches to the rewind state and moves the input head left to cell
$n$, leaving the work tape and the work head unchanged.
